goal: Prevent incoming TCP urgent data from causing the network event loop to spin in a busy loop on POSIX systems
Preserve failed connect detection on Windows while disconnecting established peers on socket exceptions
reviewability: Ready to review; nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Substantive support because it fixes the issue in P2P (darosior)
Prefers always failing on error or exception during a wait over ignoring it outside Windows (darosior)
Asked for the rationale behind the second commit (darosior)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because peers sending TCP urgent data can leave socket exceptions pending in select() on POSIX systems
This prevents a denial-of-service condition where the node network event loop consumes excessive CPU
